findings: The driver binds its exact context SHA, candidate commit/tree/4025-member identity, private root/cwd/script and -I -S -B interpreter flags before the work.

The sole child command is the fixed source_worker with source/manifest/generated paths. The child environment contains only the declared PATH, C.UTF-8 locale and bytecode-off setting; it does not repurpose HOME.

run_workflow_step receives seconds=60. The separately read original receipt must equal the returned dict, bind command/cwd/60, have completed0 without timeout, signals or cleanup errors. The actual frozen a07d helper returns precisely its on-disk report and does not add wrapper-only fields.

The workflow helper proves only its POSIX process group. The driver explicitly reports the independent180/3 outer requirement and never upgrades its own success beyond SOURCE_DRIVER_PASS_PENDING_OUTER_GUARDIAN.
Both original stdout/stderr are read and bound to the workflow receipt SHA fields. The worker report must retain source-only scope and every listed native/product/cold/activation flag is false.

The successful path independently rereads both full source snapshots, the Core document and generated assembly, comparing complete byte/identity records against the actual worker report. The two source snapshot byte streams must be exactly equal.

The worker itself observes the fixed4025-member manifest and complete physical namespace, parses the two new source files, performs fresh public Core render/roundtrip and deterministic regeneration, checks the12-function ABI and original per-function/aggregate caps, then captures source/manifest again before source-only success.

Source-worker exceptions or final drift force HOLD. Driver exceptions force HOLD; final inputs/context drift also forces HOLD. Only the pending successful state can transition to the pending-outer state.

Controlled IO retains the complete no-symlink parent chain during read/create, verifies descriptor/name identities before and after, uses bounded regular reads and create-only originals with fsync/readback. It makes no across-exec filesystem lock claim.
remaining_required_outer_work: The controller, policy, diagnostics, workflow and final independent natural180/3 guardian acceptance are absent from this incomplete draft and were not reviewed.

Final evidence collection must use the fixed original output/log names even when the worker fails. The driver binds outputs only after a successful step; a failed worker may have created valuable source/assembly/report bytes that will not appear in driver.outputs.

The future outer verifier must bind the exact original guardian/request/command/environment and require natural ECHILD/reaped/no surviving children/no kill or overflow. This driver alone does not establish those facts.
The fixed input-map membership, exact manifest body and final executable control inventory must be checked when the complete policy is frozen.
